description: MultiAppIDV4.0 is a highly secured smartcard platform compliant with the Javacard 3.0.4, GP 2.2.1, Amdt D standards, designed to operate with the Infineon SLE78 M7892 chips. It supports: TDES, AES, AES-CMAC, SHA1-224-256-384-512, RSA, RSA CRT, ECDSA, ECC CDH, KDF SP800-108 & DRBG SP800-90A algorithms.
